{"featureId":"GET_SERVICE_DETAILS","appName":"CMS","username":"6D","password":"6D","reqTxnId":"100","msgOrigin":"ORI","msgDest":"DEST","timestamp":"","id":"","ruletype":"","data":{"detail":{"rules":{"id":"0","pid":"#","childrens":[{"id":"0_0","pid":"0","type":"conditions","option":"All","childrens":[{"pid":"0_0","type":"condition","operator":"=","id":"0_0_0","values":{"value":"PROMO1"},"profile":{"id":"100","name":"L_ACTION_KEY"}}]}],"schedule":{"field":[{"name":"ScheduleId","value":"ReplaceScheduledId"},{"name":"SqlQuery","value":"Select F.Msisdn from (select distinct A.MSISDN ,Max_Rev from (select distinct X.MSISDN , GREATEST(coalesce(rev_30d,0),coalesce(rev_60d ,0), coalesce(rev_90d ,0), coalesce(rev_lst_mnth,0)) Max_Rev,case when X.activation_Date >= current_date - 30 then 'AON<90' else 'AON>90' end AON, current_date - Activation_Date AON_Days,
nationality,coalesce(rev_30d,0)rev_30d, coalesce(rev_60d ,0)rev_60d, coalesce(rev_90d ,0)rev_90d,coalesce(rev_lst_mnth,0)rev_lst_mnth from cvm.v_umas_d_profile_complete X left join (select msisdn , 
    sum(case when event_date between current_date - 30 and current_date -1 then balance_revenue_amt end) Rev_30D,
    sum(case when event_date between current_date - 60 and current_date -31 then balance_revenue_amt end) Rev_60D,
    sum(case when event_date between current_date - 90 and current_date -61 then balance_revenue_amt end) Rev_90D,
    sum(case when event_date between last_day(add_months(current_date,-2))+1 and last_day(add_months(current_date,-1))+1 then balance_revenue_amt end) Rev_LST_MNTH
    FROM DATA_MARTS.DM_USG_F_RATEDVIEW
    WHERE EVENT_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE - 90 AND EVENT_DATE < CURRENT_DATE 
    and billing_type ='PREPAID'
    and balance_revenue_amt is not null
    group by 1
    ) Y on X.msisdn = Y.msisdn 
where X.id_bnss_unit =1 and X.status = 'Active' and X.line_type ='Mobile Prepaid' 
 AND X.MSISDN NOT IN (
            SELECT MSISDN FROM DATA_MARTS.DM_USG_F_RATEDVIEW WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_DATE IS NOT NULL 
            AND EVENT_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE - 121 AND EVENT_DATE < CURRENT_DATE - 1
            AND PROD_PRCA_ID IN ( 'USG_1170870','USG_1170880','USG_1170890','USG_1180160') AND MSISDN IS NOT null
            union
            select msisdn from CVM.v_cvm_model_subscriber_profile vcmsp where data_sim_user_flag_30d = 'Y'
            )
)A left join 
(select MSISDN, 1 HAYYAK_FLAG from data_marts.dm_usg_f_ratedview dufr where event_date >= current_date - 40
and measure_code_id =6 and subscription_date  is not null 
and prod_prca_id  in ( select prod_prca_id from cvm.hyk_plus_products hpp)
group by 1) B on A.msisdn = B.MSISDN)F
WHERE F.Max_Rev>1.5 and F.Max_Rev<=2.5"},{"name":"SqlGroupName","value":"ProfileCdrPostgress"},{"name":"ScheduleName","value":"Pocket_size_3"},{"name":"AudienceSegmentation","value":"true"},{"name":"ScheduleType","value":"ScheduleNow"},{"name":"CAMPAIGN_ID","value":"100"},{"name":"CAMPAIGN_NAME","value":"DUMMY_CAMP"},{"name":"Priority","value":"1"},{"name":"Threshold","value":"NORMAL"},{"name":"ThresholdProcess","value":"SINGLE"},{"name":"Repeat","value":"true"},{"name":"LastFetchNeeded","value":"false"},{"name":"StartDate","value":"19/5/2024"},{"name":"ExpiryDate","value":"23/12/2026"},{"name":"RSP_URL","value":"UIRESPONSE"}]}}}}}
